claims.text: rain runs down a bus window at night while the city slides past outside
Added visual details are creative: beaded droplets, condensation trails, amber and red bokeh, a dark vinyl seat edge, and a faint metal fitting.
Added ambient sound details are creative: soft rain patter and a muffled bus engine hum.

summary.text: A quiet night bus ride seen through rain-streaked glass as city lights slide past.

soundscape: Soft rain patter on glass over a muffled bus engine hum, with a faint interior resonance.

description.text: Night rain beads across the glass of a bus window, each droplet catching small amber and red highlights from the city beyond. The outside world is reduced to soft, smeared bokeh: streetlamps, shop signs, and passing headlights drifting in slow lateral streaks. A thin film of condensation fogs the lower edge of the pane, and the dark rim of the bus interior sits just out of focus at the left. The glass trembles faintly with the engine, making the reflected lights shiver. Droplets gather, merge, and begin to sag into short vertical trails, while the blurred city slides steadily past. The mood is quiet, enclosed, and rain-softened, with the window acting as both a lens and a membrane between the warm interior and the wet street.
Rain beads and quivers on the pane as blurred city lights drift behind it.
A soft patter of rain on glass sits under a muffled bus engine hum.
Several droplets merge and start to run in short, wavering trails.

At the center of the pane, one rivulet becomes the focus. It cuts a wavering path through the condensation, swelling as it collects smaller beads and leaving a clear, glossy line behind. Beyond the window, streetlights and neon signage slide past in long, smeared bands of amber, red, and pale white; their motion is steady and lateral, as if the bus is carrying the glass through a current of light. The water distorts the outside world into shifting vertical stripes, and tiny droplets tremble at the edges of the main trail. The glass is cool and slick, with scattered microdroplets and a faint haze where moisture has gathered. The rivulet pauses, swerves around a speck, then continues downward.
A single rivulet swells and cuts a wavering path through the condensation.
Rain patter stays soft while the low engine drone continues.
Amber and red light bands slide sideways beyond the wet glass.

The rain-streaked window shares the image with the dim edge of the bus interior: a sliver of dark vinyl, a faint metal fitting, and the suggestion of a seat back in shadow. Sheets of rain continue down the glass, some drops racing, others clinging and bulging before they break loose. Outside, the city glow sweeps past in broader, faster strokes of amber, red, and cool white, smearing across the wet pane and briefly illuminating the condensation. The interior remains mostly dark, its few highlights reflected weakly in the glass. The bus's motion makes the outside lights stretch and slide, while the rain inside the window keeps its own downward rhythm. The scene settles into a quiet, enclosed nighttime ride, with the wet glass holding both the moving city and the still, shadowed interior.
The dark edge of the bus interior appears at the side of the rain-streaked window.
Rain on glass remains steady over a faint interior hum.
Sheets of rain slide down the pane while the city glow sweeps past in faster strokes.
